text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days before the Spring Fan Fest...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You seriously think I'd wanna do that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume never refuse to join the Fan
Fest... If
they've debuted, it's always
been kind of a given
that they'd have
fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is a rare opportunity for them to
thank their
supporters up close in
person, and generally,
both sides are
really excited about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Races depend on spectators, and
therefore
fan-orientated events are held
regularly in order
to build and maintain
fan loyalty."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even that explanation doesn't quite
make sense
to me. What's the point?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well not me. They don't affect my

performance in the least.
choice_data_list: 応援が力になる子もいるから
choice_data_list_en: Because for some girls, cheering gives them strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They're just more noise. I'd prefer they
just shut
up and let me focus on the
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Shakur has fans, sadly, their
voices
aren't reaching her. She blocks
out all the noise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's out of character, considering
she usually
prides herself on acting
rationally. She doesn't
need to be
grateful for her fans, but I wish she'd
at
least realize they're out there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: 交渉次第では参加してくれる？
choice_data_list_en: Would you join depending on the negotiations?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't think so. Kick and scream
all you
want, but there's nothin' in it for
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to have to resort to bribing her,
but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list_en: A new 'U-MAX226' is coming out, isn't it...!
A new 'U-MAX226' is coming out, right...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
U-MAX226 is a sneaker line that Air
Shakur is
particularly fond of. They're
quite popular among
the younger
generations.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, they are. What about it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You will, will you? And what if I say I
don't need
you to?
choice_data_list_en: Stand in line at the shop instead.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I could just preorder a pair. Which means
I don't
have to resort to negotiating with
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Check and mate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...But you know what? Whatever. I'll give
it a go.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But I'm only gonna show up. I won't be
competing
or anythin'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah? It's a deal, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as she's there, the voices of her
fans will
surely reach her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the Fan Fest arrives.
Air
Shakur is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ugh, it's so loud.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Nah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following that, I resume my efforts to
convince
Shakur to participate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I somehow manage to talk
her into to
joining the Fan Fest. But...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's Air Shakur! I didn't know she
came to these
things.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oooh, she's so intense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being an event hosted by Tracen
Academy, most
of the attendees are
friendly faces. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ahhh. I see what you're up to.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're tryin' to give me a shot of
motivation,
aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Show me I got nothing but hate comin'
my way.
Interesting.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll bite. I'll scare the hell out of
everyone
at the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm going back now. You can stay here if
you
want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her interpreting it in the exact
opposite
way I meant it, this may have
actually been the
best way to strengthen
Air Shakur's resolve.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Oh... She left.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I should've gone and talked to her. I
know Shakur
doesn't like people
bothering her, but...

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Still... I wanted to tell her I'll be cheering
for her at the
spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Fine. If the terms are right.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's actually good timing. There's
something I've
been wantin' to try.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's an event where the trainers race
each
other this year.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just for fun, I put together a training
schedule for
humans once as a thought
exercise.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've never tested it, though... So? Sounds
like fun,
right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're not liftin' your legs enough.
There's no
point if you don't. Go do five
more laps.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, check it out. That's one of the
students
from Tracen Academy. Must be
a race coming up
because she's really
going all out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You're draggin' your feet again.
You wanna
run even more laps?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a second... Is that the trainer
running?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I follow the training plan that
Air Shakur
devised for a few days, until...

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Aaand they're off! The 1,600-meter
trainer race
has begun!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Used to calling the shots, now the
trainers are
putting their expertise to the
test as they power
through this
1,600-meter course!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
They're onto the final stretch! Which of
our fierce
trainers will claim victory?

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! One trainer is surging
forward with
incredible speed!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: There it is.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Aaand just like that, everyone else has
been left
in the dust! And the winner is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey. Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's room for improvement. If we
start
prepping for the next race right n—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, listen to me. What's the point in
thinking
about next time?

text_block_list.text:
In the end, I somehow manage to talk
her into to
joining the Fan Fest. But...

Okay, I'll bite. I'll scare the hell out of

I should've gone and talked to her. I
